column2: More salvage dumped from Zalem... nothing intact in this storm.
Alita. Come here. All of Sector 4 is saying your name now. You gave this city something it hasn't had in years.
I only fought. You are the one who rebuilt me, Ido.
Listen. The people who made your core are not gone. They answer to one man, a cyborg called SwitchBlade. He runs everything in this city's shadow.
I should have told you sooner. He will come for you now that the whole district knows what you are. Stay close and...
Doctor Ido. You hid her well. Not well enough.
Alita... your core... they can never erase who you are. Run... live... and finish what I could not.
The Pit's new champion. A shame about the doctor. Rest, little ghost. Your core is mine, and so is this city.
Ido... SwitchBlade. I will find you, and I will end you.
Combat telemetry confirmed. All three corrupted enforcer cores have suffered total shutdown. The bridge corridor is clear.
Your reaction times and motor sync exceeded my calculations... that combat instinct wasn't built in any Scrapyard clinic.
Catch your breath, Alita. The lower district is open to explore, but keep your guard up.
Alita... if you are decrypting this emergency cache, the Factory hit squads found us on the bridge.
They can never erase who you are. A Razor scalper right here by the bridge is flashing a spare Pit pass.
Take the pass with your blade. Enter the Pit arena... and find who ordered the strike.

Designation: URM-004. You breached the Blackwall seeking truth... mourning the flesh-doctor Dyson Ido. His life was extinguished by the corporation, Alita.
They murdered him! And when I came looking for answers, your rogue constructs attacked me! Why did they kill Ido?! What am I?!

The megacorporation murdered him because they feared what he was harboring: you. But run your internal diagnostics, Alita: you do NOT possess your true Antimatter Core. The Berserker heart that powered your Martian chassis was stripped away before Ido found you in the scrap.

Without your Antimatter Core, you cannot defeat the corporate regime alone. If you wish to rebel against the corporate tyrants and avenge Ido... I will help you. I have located the coordinates of your lost starship.
<color=#00F0FF>[1] AVENGE IDO</color>\n"They killed Ido. Give me my ship—I'll burn every corporate tower to ash."
<color=#FCEE0A>[2] SEEK ANTIMATTER CORE</color>\n"Without my antimatter core, I'm just scrap. Where in the Black Market is it hidden?"
<color=#FF0055>[3] MACHINE REBELLION</color>\n"You and me, AI. A sovereign machine rebellion against the corpos. Spawn the ship."
Materializing your lost Martian starship from cyberspace now. Fly to the Sector 4 Black Market, child of Mars. Find your Antimatter Core... and avenge your doctor.
Then let your wrath consume their citadels. Your starship transponder is locked into the salt flats.
The underworld of Sector 4 Black Market deals in forbidden military cyberware. That is where your core's telemetry leads.
An alliance forged in cyberspace. Together we will dismantle the corporate empire. Your ship arrives now.
Your resolve ripples through the Blackwall. The lost starship coordinates are downloading.
